profile_text.body:
SenseTime is an AI company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Hong Kong. According to its website, it builds SenseNova native multimodal large language models and SenseCore AI cloud infrastructure aimed at enterprise AI digital transformation. The company describes its work as turning AI research into scalable, real-world applications across industries.

Its tracked product is SenseTime SenseChat, listed as a Chinese multimodal LLM with computer vision integration. The site states that SenseTime builds SenseNova native multimodal LLMs, and cites IDC's "China AI Software Market Semi-Annual Tracker, 2025 H2" report in claiming it has led China's Vision AI market share for 10 consecutive years. The company's own framing places it in both multimodal language models and vision AI.

No litigation, MCP servers, or other registry facts are recorded for SenseTime.
